items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: My recording activities started the 7th of July when I recorded with Dicky Wells' Orchestra which included Bill Dillard, Shad Collins...

ctx.x: Teddy had changed a few musicians since I left the band in 1935. Bob Carroll, ex-Redman alumnus, was on tenor, having replaced Chu Berry; Wilbur de Paris had been added on trombone, and a young 18-year old trumpet played named John Burks Gillespie whom the other fellows in the band called Dizzy. Dizzy had replaced Frank Newton who had come in the band after I left.

My recording activities started the 7th of July when I recorded with Dicky Wells' Orchestra which included Bill Dillard, Shad Collins, who had replaced Roy Eldridge, Dicky, Django Reinhardt, Richard Fullbright on bass and Bill Beeson on drums.
